subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in the
stimulus: parentheses. 1×5= 5 Rabindranath Tagore, one of the greatest literary figures of the world, won Nobel Prize for 'Gitanjali' in 1913. That brought him tremendous (a) ----- (repute) ----- and recognition which he cherished in his life. Towards the end of his career he paid attention to painting. His pictures too according to the critics belong to a very high rank. Indeed Tagore (b) ----- (hard) ----- did anything (c) ----- (standard) ----- in his life. His Galpaguchha is an (d) ----- (ordinary) ----- literary creation of short stories. They are about social and (e) ----- (psychology) ----- elements of the people of our society. For example, in Haimanti, Rabindranath has nicely portrayed a social problem named dowry.
guide_solution: Adding suffix, prefix or both: (a) reputation; (b) hardly; (c) sub-standard; (d) extraordinary; (e) psychological.
